host.note: shared epic host; the CI Linux runner's measurer floor is lower (2.97 MiB, 0.55 ms CPU)

prototype.source: out of tree (Rust outside a workspace member fails cargo xtask check-reach); the shape below is what was built
shape: one binary `toolu`, clap 4 derive tree: global --json/--host/--config-dir/--quiet and 19 namespaces (hook, ledger, doctor, config, status, commands, serve, ts-quality, python-quality, rust-quality, ast-grep, jev, statusline, review, babysit, epic, plugins, brainstorm, delivery-flow) with 66 subcommands
`toolu hook <entry>` fast path: argv[1] == "hook" dispatches before the clap tree is built (PROTO_NO_FAST_PATH=1 forces the full tree for comparison)
every hook: stdin JSON via serde_json, user and project toolu.config.json, the pre-tools.d registry listing, the gate file and .git/HEAD from the toplevel found by walking up to .git
post-tools: gate file rewritten under an O_EXCL <file>.lock with tmp + rename
jev ask links ureq + rustls (not called on the hook path)
statusline render: payload, gate file and branch read, one line printed
epic serve: loopback TcpListener, one thread per connection, keep-alive HTTP/1.1, a 50-task JSON status body written in one write with TCP_NODELAY

method.hooks: bun run bench:hooks --only toolu/pre-tools --only toolu/post-tools --runs 30 --warmup 3 with TOOLU_IMPL=rust:toolu/pre-tools,toolu/post-tools and TOOLU_RUST_BIN_DIR=<prototype>/target/release; the bench runs `/bin/sh -c 'exec "$0" "$@"' toolu hook <entry>` through cargo xtask measure
method.surfaces: a scratch probe: `toolu --version` and `toolu statusline render` through cargo xtask measure (30 runs after 3 warm-up), the idle `toolu epic serve` VmRSS after 2 s, then 50 concurrent Bun fetch clients x 40 keep-alive requests (client-side latency, server VmHWM)
method.gate: the `cargo xtask gate` step of the required rust jobs in the three #455-era CI runs (warm rust-cache)
